changes.title: Legend batch
items: Ten legends are now the ancient elders of their kinds: the wolf howls rings of moonlight, the stag's huge antlers burn at every tip, the elk carries glowing pools in its antlers, the bear towers with glowing claws, the otter floats on its back holding a pearl, the beaver grips a gnawed log, the toad swells a glowing throat sac, the owl stares from an enormous ringed face, the lynx has long glowing ear plumes and the boar ploughs up the earth

changes.title: Roe elder
items: The roe deer's legend is now the elder of the roe: an ancient grey-muzzled buck with heavy, mossy, many-tined antlers, a pale winter ruff and bead offerings round its legs
The mossy dell grows mostly rowan now, with birch and oak

changes.title: Erg trees
items: The Erg grows thorn trees and the odd baobab among its date palms, and its saltbush now shows

changes.title: Meerkat
items: A new animal for the badlands: the meerkat, scurrying about its red-rock warren under twisted junipers and sitting up as a lookout when it stops
Its legend's boon, Lookout: your 💌s reach further

changes.title: Home forest mammals
items: Home is now all green woods and mostly furry friends: a fox in the old oaks, a hare in the bluebell glade, a mole in the fern forest, a badger in the wispy forest, a stoat in the alder forest, a squirrel in the twiggy forest and a pine marten in the old pinewood
The owl, toad and beetle now live further out, on the islands
The owl now nests at the stone shrine, glowworms light the meadow, the boar roots in the grassland, woodlice live on the moor, the snake basks on Norway's slate and the wolf prowls the lost garden
